desc: Implement the corrected run-matching DP: compress each case into runs, detect good 4-run blocks with singleton middle runs, compute the maximum number of compatible good blocks via dp[k]=max(dp[k-1], dp[k-3]+1), and output R-dp[R].
Verify the solution on the provided samples and edge cases (R<4, all equal, all distinct, many small test cases); sample tests passed.
Finalize fast I/O and O(total N) complexity for T up to 1e5.
